name: Whist
detailed_description:
You are just an ordinary teenager in a medieval village. But one day, your life changes, and you embark on the path of a healer and adventurer. Your main goal? Listen to your mentor and find a cure for all diseases by studying and overcoming every illness you encounter. Will you rely on cold steel in battle, or unleash the power of magic? What potions will you prepare? The choice is yours—but remember, this is not a fight for survival, but a fight for life itself.

Features

  • Inventory. No endlessly cluttered backpack filled with useless junk. And you don’t need an inventory just to change your character’s appearance!

  • Combat system. Face unique enemies in every chronotope. The bosses in Whist won’t let you get bored.

  • Immersion in historical medicine. Discover real medieval treatments and apply them in battle.

  • Talent system. Simple yet flexible—allowing you to tailor your combat style for each challenge and opponent.

  • Unique visual style. Inspired by medieval manuscripts, medical books, and fantasy literature.

  • Music. Composed with love by a young yet incredibly talented musician who has adored games since childhood.

Each disease and injury you encounter believes itself to be the most important, so you won’t face the same enemy twice. Study their behavior to outsmart them in battle.

Every fight is like a game of cards. Decide what you’re willing to sacrifice and what will be your trump card—but beware, illness never plays fair.

Craft your own potions—but to do so, you’ll need to master botany. Thankfully, you have an experienced mentor by your side.

Choose your own path as a healer through the talent system. Do you prefer an aggressive therapeutic assault or a more strategic, long-range approach? Let the stars guide you to victory.

short_description: Become a healer in Whist – a single-player turn-based RPG. Challenge cunning diseases. Learn the art of healing, brew and stock up on potions, and solve puzzles. Plan your moves ahead, allocate your talents, and don’t rush to reveal all your cards — illnesses are not as simple as they seem!
